instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Bosnian tweet convey: positive, neutral or negative?
instructions.rule: Pick negative only for sincere distress (sadness, heartbreak, painful exhaustion), hostility, contempt, insults or disgust toward people, or news about accidents, deaths, incidents, scandals or disputes. Pick positive for warmth, affection, flirting, enjoyment, explicit agreement or friendly invitations, praise, and news about wins, agreements, institutional progress, festivals or new services. Personal anecdotes, curious questions, mild comic exaggerations about one's own body or day, sayings, lyrics, sports fixtures, science or weather items, schedules and shop ads are neutral. Laughter or emoticons alone do not make a text positive.

neutral.what: No clear feeling: everyday anecdotes, curious or puzzled questions, mild comic exaggerations about oneself, sayings, quotes, lyrics, check-ins, schedules, shop ads, sports fixtures, science or weather items.
examples: Ne mogu više ovih čajeva,bešika će da mi eksplodira. (Can't take more teas, my bladder will explode.)
Kako objasniti to da neko zivi u Njemackoj godinama i pise StuDgart????????? (How to explain someone living in Germany for years writing StuDgart?)
15 minuta trazim fen koji mi se nalazi ispod stola (15 minutes looking for the hairdryer that was under the table)
Hrvatska protiv Brazila otvara Mundijal (Croatia vs Brazil opens the World Cup)
neutral.cues: ?, zašto (why), ko normalan (who in their right mind), i ostale misterije (and other mysteries), I'm at, pogledajte ponudu (see the offer), večeras u (tonight at)
neutral.not_for: Sincere suffering, contempt for people or bad-news headlines are negative. Clear affection, enjoyment or constructive news is positive.

positive.what: Warmth, affection, flirting, enjoyment, explicit agreement or invitations toward someone, praise, or news about wins, agreements, institutional progress, festivals, culture and new services.
examples: @rooster_62 hahaha tako je! Nema predaje. (hahaha that's right! No surrender.)
zaljubi se u mene, hitno mi je (fall in love with me, it's urgent)
Čelik i Velež ostvarili ubjedljive pobjede (Čelik and Velež won convincingly)
positive.cues: volim (I love), uživanje (enjoyment), gotivim (I like), tako je (that's right), baš tako (exactly so), dobro jutro (good morning), naleti (drop by), <3, pobjede (wins), dogovor (agreement), počinje (starts), podrška (support)
positive.not_for: Jokes, anecdotes or questions that only add haha, :P or xD are neutral. Sad content ending in :) is negative.

negative.what: Sincere sadness, heartbreak, painful exhaustion, anger, hate, contempt or insults toward people, disgust, or headlines about accidents, deaths, incidents, crime, scandal or disputes.
examples: neprospavane noci ++ (sleepless nights)
I opet ko god te spomene mene srce puca. Ali ne dam da se to prmjeti :) (Whenever someone mentions you my heart breaks, but I hide it)
Ti ljudi koju napadaju druge kad kasne, a kad oni kasne to je sasvim ok. (Those people who attack others for being late, but it's fine when they're late.)
Incident u Trebinju (Incident in Trebinje)
negative.cues: jebem (f***), mrzim (I hate), fuj (yuck), glupan (idiot), srce puca (heart breaks), tuga (sadness), placem (I cry), nesreća (accident), ubistvo (murder), -_-, :(
negative.not_for: Light self-mockery, odd observations about one's own day or body, and puzzled questions are neutral.
